# ACT NOW — recalled stock is on our shelves

**fda:H-1355-2026** · Taylor Fresh Foods Inc · 2026-08-07

> Pico De Gallo. Ingredients: Tomato, Onion, Jalapeno Pepper, Cilantro, Garlic, Salt, Black Pepper. Net Wt: 7 oz. Keep…

## Why
The FDA recall notice from Taylor Fresh Foods Inc. identifies Pico De Gallo with UPC 688267575778 as potentially contaminated with Salmonella and lists specific lot codes TFNE210A, TFNE212A, and TFNE213A [E1][E2][E3][E6][E7]. Our product matching confirms these exact lot codes are present in our inventory under the listed-lots rule [E9][E10]. We currently hold 398 units of these recalled lots across 8 stores, and 156 units have been sold to 82 loyalty customers since the recall date of 2026-08-07 [E11][E12][E13][E14][E4].

## What we matched
- `NW-100039` PICO DE GALLO 7OZ — **same** (rule, upc): our UPC 688267575778 is printed in the notice
- `NW-100080` MILD PICO DE GALLO 10OZ — **not-this** (agent-memory, text): earlier run decided: notice is about "Pico De Gallo"

## Actions
- Pull lots TFNE210A, TFNE212A, TFNE213A from 8 store(s): S008 (93), S002 (74), S024 (60), S022 (58), S015 (44), S009 (33) [E12]
- Send recall notice to loyalty customers who bought affected lots since 2026-08-07: at most 82 [E14]
- Contact Supplier S007 (synthetic) for credit and replacement [E15]

## Caveats
- Retailer data is synthetic (Northwind Mercantile, generated for this demo).
- Stores in CA, OR hold stock although the notice's distribution list does not name those states — product can travel through distributors, so this is not a clearance.
- Customer count sums weekly distinct counts, so it is an upper bound.

# ACT NOW — recalled stock is on our shelves

## Why
The FDA recall notice from NatureBest Pre-Cut & Produce LLC identifies HEB-PICO-MEDIUM-12/14oz as potentially contaminated with Salmonella due to jalapeños [E1][E2][E3]. Our product match confirms SKU NW-100115 corresponds exactly to the noticed product name [E7], and the listed-lots rule verifies that our affected lots are the three codes named in the notice [E8][E9]. We currently hold 95 units of these recalled lots across 4 stores [E10][E11][E15], and 56 units have been sold to 24 loyalty customers since the recall date of 2026-08-05 [E4][E12][E13].

## What we matched
- `NW-100010` PICO DE GALLO-MILD-4OZ PICO DE — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "HEB-PICO-MEDIUM-12/14oz PICO DE GALLO-MEDIUM-6/14oz PICO DE GALLO-MEDIUM-6/9oz PICO-DE-GALLO-MEDIUM-BGC-1/5# PICO-MEDIUM-SNACK-12/4oz"
- `NW-100115` HEB-PICO-MEDIUM-12/14OZ PICO DE — **same** (judge, text): notice names "HEB-PICO-MEDIUM-12/14oz"

## Actions
- Pull lots 400B26197, 400B26202, 400B26210 from 4 store(s): S009 (44), S014 (33), S018 (10), S010 (8) [E11]
- Send recall notice to loyalty customers who bought affected lots since 2026-08-05: at most 24 [E13]
- Contact Supplier S013 (synthetic) for credit and replacement [E14]

## Caveats
- Retailer data is synthetic (Northwind Mercantile, generated for this demo).
- Stores in IL, WI, NJ hold stock although the notice's distribution list does not name those states — product can travel through distributors, so this is not a clearance.
